lastTask: Implement Byte 17a SongGoal contract and deterministic interpreter

projectState.summary: Byte 17a is implemented on codex/byte-17a. The new SongGoal contract lives in src/song-goal.ts with closed vocabularies, clamped numeric ranges, deterministic keyword interpretation, stable ids, and brief generation. The app exposes an inspect-only Song Goal panel and window.songGoal.* harness. It intentionally does not drive tempo, key/mode, form, player behavior, playback, lookahead, or persistence yet; Byte 17b is the first setup-drive slice. Validation so far: npm run build and npm run smoke (35/35) are green.
